name: Notification Panel
description: Opens from the bell, closes on Escape, grouped by day and filtered by kind — and it draws the difference between what you have seen and what you have actually dealt with, which most notification UIs collapse and cannot uncollapse. More at layro.vercel.app
author: uvain
oQueDa: Painel de notificações (sino), agrupado por dia, filtro por tipo, Esc fecha.
ondeVai: Central de alertas (publicações DJEN, prazos, WhatsApp enviado).
adaptacaoMarca: Tipos: Publicação, Prazo, WhatsApp, Sistema; framer-motion → motion/react.
compat: React 19/Next 16/Tailwind v4: revisar 'use client', trocar framer-motion por motion/react quando aparecer; cores hardcoded → tokens do globals.css.
